items.text: In adults with insulin-treated diabetes having elective surgery, does the perioperative glucose protocol, compared with usual care, reduce the proportion with capillary glucose above 12 or below 4 mmol/L on the day of surgery?
items.population: Adults with insulin-treated diabetes having elective general, orthopaedic or urological surgery
items.outcome: Glucose out of range on the day of surgery
items.time: Day of surgery and 24 hours after

items.text: Can the protocol be delivered and can outcomes be measured completely across the three specialties, and what proportion of eligible patients agree to take part?
items.outcome: Recruitment, delivery and outcome completeness rates

finer: The effect question needs more patients than one hospital sees quickly; the deliverability question is feasible now and would decide whether an effect study is worth running.
